UI layout update focused on keeping the main dashboard clean while still offering rich host charts.

---

## What's changed

### Proxmox card
- Reverted Proxmox back to a **normal app card** in the apps grid (no special stream-card styling).

### New System Telemetry page
- Added a dedicated page at `/telemetry` with AMUD-style charts:
  - CPU (model, cores, temp + chart)
  - RAM (chart + used/total)
  - Disk usage (chart + used/total)
  - Network bandwidth chart (internal + external combined)
  - GPU chart (only when `nvidia-smi` is available on the Proxmox host agent)
- Added a **System** button in the dashboard topbar to open this page quickly.

### Dashboard stays app-focused
- Removed the big host/GPU sparklines from the main dashboard row to keep apps and services the priority.

---

## Upgrade

On your Proxmox LXC:

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Verify version in **Settings → System** shows `v1.4.2.0`.
